A '''heavy weapons squad''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. Similar to a standard [[line squad]], heavy weapons squads were equipped with either a two-man [[Medium repeating blaster/Legends|medium repeating blaster]], three-man medium repeating blaster, or a three-man [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]].<ref name="ISB" />
